name: plan-slack-stale-and-drop
about: Planning scenario 4 in #plan, and dropping plans from Slack. The approver presses Approve brief v1 after the agent wrote v2: the echo waits the 2 minutes, then says it was not applied ("the brief changed; approve v2 instead") and the plan stays at brief. Someone else's Drop press is refused; the approver's Drop (after Slack's confirmation) drops the plan, the header loses its Drop button and the turn queued meanwhile fails ("Refused drop from someone else" and "Dropped by you" in the thread). A second plan, started with /loop plan, gets a thread the bot opens in #plan, and /loop drop P2 drops it; /loop plans then lists nothing.
